entry.title: CVE-2025-42884 · SAP NetWeaver · due Nov 23
entry.summary: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability. Added Nov 20, due Nov 23. Known ransomware use: Unknown. CVErdict score 90/100.
entry.content:
SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.
Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

entry.title: CVE-2026-90817 · Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) · due Nov 21
entry.summary: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability. Added Nov 18, due Nov 21. Known ransomware use: Unknown. Forensic triage requested (BOD 26-04). CVErdict score 100/100.
entry.content:
Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. entry.title: CVE-2026-115731 · Perforce Puppet Enterprise · due Dec 1
entry.summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability. Added Nov 17, due Dec 1. Known ransomware use: Unknown. CVErdict score 100/100.
entry.content:
Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.
Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes).
